extension.summary: Clear caches, reload PVR, and maintain media libraries
extension.description: Clears Kodi's temporary cache and downloaded installation packages, reloads enabled PVR clients, then lets the user choose whether to scan and clean the video and music libraries without restarting Kodi.
extension.news: Add a summary and choice after cache, package, and PVR maintenance so library scanning and cleaning can be skipped.
